<cite ref="Proverbs 22:4">Prov. XXII, 4</cite>) <he>מה … עשת ענוה עקב לסוּלְיָיסָהּ</he> that (fear of the Lord) which Wisdom makes the crown of her head, Humility makes the imprint of her shoe; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 960:2">Yalk. Prov. 960</cite> <he>עשתה ענוה סוליית לרגלה</he> (corr. acc.) Humility makes the shoe of her foot.—Hebr. adapt.: <cite ref="O00320"><he>סוֹלִּית</he></cite> (as if from <cite ref="O01004"><he>סָלַל</he> II</cite>). Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Genesis 1:1">B’resh. 1</cite> <he>סוֹלִּיתָה ענוה וכ׳</he> the Law,—her shoe (footprint) is humility, her crown, fear.
